title: Yellow Earthy Scottish Mushrooms Welsh Rarebit
description: A savory and earthy Scottish dish featuring mushrooms and a crunchy coco sugar crust, served en-croute in a satvik-friendly Welsh rarebit form, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a pan, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the Scottish wild mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
In a separate bowl, mix the coco sugar, nutritional yeast, and lemon juice to create the rarebit sauce.
Butter the whole wheat bread slices with vegan butter.
Spoon the mushroom mixture onto the bread slices, followed by a spoonful of the rarebit sauce.
Place the bread slices in a baking dish and sprinkle with additional coco sugar.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the bread is toasted.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately.
